data.name: Fareesa
data.gender_notes: Fareesa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'fararasa' which means 'to be radiant, to shine'. The name Fareesa is derived from the Quranic term 'Fir'asah' which means 'shining, bright, radiant'. This name was given to a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and is mentioned in various Hadiths. The name Fareesa carries the meaning “Bright, Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fareesa usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects the light of God and radiates His love and blessings.
data.etymology: Fareesa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Radiant, Shining One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fareesa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
